The main takeaway from our work is that
the accuracy and computational cost of event-based optical flow algorithms is comparable to frame-based algorithms.

optical flow can be computed in real-time on a DAVIS camera, and that the algorithms can be implemented on embedded platforms with limited computational power, which makes it possible to apply them to a wide range of mobile and autonomous applications.
event-based algorithms are a promising alternative to frame-based methods, especially for applications with high frame rate and/or low computational cost.
